text:
mira: quick heads-up — PR #7349 is ready but gated on RFC sign-off. RFC here: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/409-kv-cache-routing. Need arch ack for fallback semantics and design ack for the client-facing retry hint UX. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7349
aj: can you summarize exactly what we changed vs current behavior? trying to see risk surface for canary.
mira: sure — short summary: we add a routing rule that sends requests to a lighter quantized model on cache miss + a soft-fallback path that returns a 202 with a retry_hint header instead of blocking. main risk: mismatch in client retry logic and potential rate spikes to fallback pool.
leo: can you paste the code path where the 202 is returned?
mira: snippet: ```js
if (!kvCache.has(prefix)) {
  routeTo(fallbackPool);
  return Response(202, { 'retry_hint': '10s' });
}
```
katie: design-team — we need a quick signoff on the retry_hint header and UX. Is returning 202 + header fine or do you want a structured JSON body?
design-team: quick note — lean toward JSON body (`{status: "degraded", retry_after: 10}`) so mobile SDKs parse consistently. can approve if server returns that shape.
mira: thanks — I can change to JSON body in the PR, small patch.
aj: arch-bot — tagging architecture for behavioral signoff, especially around load shift to fallbackPool. @arch-bot any concerns re autoscaler config?
arch-bot: FYI: autoscaler alerting thresholds will need a small tweak. see ops doc: https://redwood.infra/ops/autoscaler#fallback-pools — recommend temporary +20% headroom for first canary window.
ci-bot: All checks passed — CI build #1123 green :white_check_mark:. integration-tests: 42 passed, 1 flaky (ignored).
mira: plan: update response shape to JSON per design, add autoscaler change to the canary playbook, then request arch + design ack. scheduling canary for tomorrow 09:00 PT if we get signoffs today. if issues, rollback and open hotfix. @aj @leo @katie @design-team @arch-bot
leo: ack, will review the tiny JSON change now.
aj: digging into the autoscaler note now, will comment on PR about thresholds.
mira: thanks — will ping again once I push the patch. :thumbsup:
